notes: Deploy only PlantOrganism on Robinhood Chain 4663. Constructor order is IMD, initial oracle signer, uint32 FALLBACK_CELL, deployer; the two addresses are fixed by the brief, 10223579 is Lisbon (0x009BFFDB; quarter-degrees 155, -37), and $owner receives the sole one-time binding authority. Location starts at 0, water at 50, and lastSettledDay at the deployment Unix day. This manifest creates no PLANT token, pool or hook and schedules no initialization calls. The separate second launch supplies PLANT and its hook. Once available, the explicit deployer alone may call bind(hook, questionHash): the hook must identify this organism and its PLANT token; binding permanently stores both and the nonzero frozen canonical oracle question hash, with no remaining deployer powers. Until bound, settle only advances the day cursor; park and redeem revert. No administrator, upgrade, pause or mutable economic parameters exist. Any received IMD enters pot after backing and gardener obligations. Anyone may submit consecutive days to settle using IdentityMD Oracle EIP-712 v2, chain 4663 and this deployed contract as verifyingContract; QUESTION_HASH must match, answerType is 5, and answer is canonical abi.encode(bytes32[]) containing exactly three words. Word 0 carries sun, rain, challenger validity/cell and Unix day; words 1 and 2 are emitted unchanged. Rain takes precedence over sun. Settlement rewards the old location's active gardeners before movement and pending activation, then pays the caller 1% of remaining pot. Support counts immediately toward movement; newly parked tokens earn only after the next settlement. claim() handles the current cell and checkpointed credits; claim(cell) also realizes rewards at a former cell. floor() is a ratio scaled by 1e18; live redemption pays 90% of proportional backing and retains redeemed PLANT forever. After 30 days without a successful bound settle, pot joins backing and redemption pays 100%; the clock starts at deployment and binding does not reset it. Death is reflected immediately in views; anyone may call syncDeath() to record it, including later deposits, while claims and unparking remain available. Anyone may relay rotateSigner(newSigner, sig), but authorization must come from the current signer over RotateSigner(address organism,address newSigner,uint256 nonce) in the same v2 domain using rotationNonce. Retired signers retain attestation authority for 30 days, never rotation authority. Integration requires exact-transfer, nonrebasing IMD and fixed-supply PLANT; bind snapshots PLANT supply and park, redeem and bound settle reject supply changes. README.md, docs/ORACLE.md and docs/ACCOUNTING.md describe the accepted interfaces and integration assumptions.
